note: Both sets share the same core member sizes (HSS4X4X1/4, W6X20, W8X10, L3x3x1/4, PL3"X1/4) and both repeat the same misbound claim that 9'-0" is the FIRST FLR/T.O. STEEL elevation above GRADE LEVEL, when 9'-0" is a plan/width dimension and the datums read 2'-4" and 11'-4". Set A adds more distinct, supported facts that B omits: the T.O. STEEL 11'-4" elevation, the 32'-0" overall dimension, 3'-1", 7 7/8", and the 1/4"=1'-0" scale for the EAST elevation. Set B's extras are mostly redundant restatements of the plate/HSS labels plus 3", 10'-0" and 8", and it drops the 11'-4" datum entirely. A's only added weakness is one vague 'unspecified structural element' claim for 8'-8 1/2".
